content: Published "Attention-enhanced multi-task learning for binary segmentation and fine-grained aquatic plant classification in UAV imagery" in Nature Scientific Reports (Q1).
Completed field visit to Bangladesh Agricultural University (BAU) for UAV-based aquatic plant data collection.
Conducted a robotics workshop at a local cadet college, introducing students to embedded systems and autonomous robots.
Research dataset work featured in The Business Standard, covering the IUB RIoT Research Center's dataset publication in Nature Scientific Data.
Paper accepted in Nature Scientific Data (Q1): "A comprehensive dataset of surface water quality spanning 1940–2023 for empirical and ML adopted research."
